danger.intro: Permanently delete your CheckStation account, this workspace, and customer-created operational data. This cannot be undone.
danger.confirmBody1: Permanent deletion removes your CheckStation account, this workspace, and customer-created operational data such as Members, Groups, kiosk configuration, staff logins, and history.
danger.confirmBody2: Your account and workspace data will be permanently deleted, except information we may be required to retain by law or for security/compliance purposes.
danger.confirmBody3: This is not logout, archive, or subscription cancellation.
danger.confirmDialog: This cannot be undone. Permanently delete your CheckStation account and workspace?
danger.oauthReauthRequired: Confirm your identity with a linked sign-in provider before permanently deleting this account.
danger.oauthReauthReady: Identity confirmed. You can continue with permanent deletion.
danger.activeSubscription: A paid subscription is still active for this workspace. Cancel it and wait until paid access ends before permanently deleting the account.
danger.activeSubscriptionHint: Deleting the account does not cancel Stripe billing. Use Subscription to cancel or end paid access first.
